qe: Who was the founder of the Nanda Dynasty in Magadha before Chandragupta Maurya?
qh: चंद्रगुप्त मौर्य से पहले मगध में नंद वंश का संस्थापक कौन था?
e: Mahapadma Nanda founded the Nanda Dynasty in Magadha; Dhana Nanda was its last ruler overthrown by Chandragupta Maurya.

qe: Where did Mahatma Gandhi launch his first Satyagraha experiment in India in 1917?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने 1917 में भारत में अपना पहला सत्याग्रह प्रयोग कहाँ शुरू किया था?
e: Invited by Rajkumar Shukla, Gandhiji led the Champaran Satyagraha in 1917 against the Tinkathia indigo plantation system.

qe: Which ruler constructed the Grand Trunk Road (Sadak-e-Azam) and introduced the silver 'Rupiya' coin?
qh: किस शासक ने ग्रांड ट्रंक रोड (सड़क-ए-आजम) का निर्माण कराया और चाँदी का 'रुपया' सिक्का चलाया?
e: Sher Shah Suri (from Sasaram, Bihar) built Sadak-e-Azam from Sonargaon to Attock and standardized the silver Rupiya.

qe: At which session of the Indian National Congress in 1922 in Bihar did Chittaranjan Das preside?
qh: 1922 में बिहार में आयोजित भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के किस अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता चित्तरंजन दास ने की थी?
e: The 1922 Gaya Congress Session was presided over by C.R. Das, leading directly to the formation of the Swaraj Party.

qe: Who led the Revolt of 1857 in Jagdishpur (Arrah), Bihar?
qh: बिहार के जगदीशपुर (आरा) में 1857 के विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: 80-year-old Rajput zamindar Babu Kunwar Singh led the 1857 uprising across Arrah, Danapur, and Azamgarh.

qe: Which ancient Buddhist council was held at Pataliputra under the patronage of Emperor Ashoka?
qh: सम्राट अशोक के संरक्षण में पाटलिपुत्र में कौन-सी प्राचीन बौद्ध संगीति आयोजित हुई थी?
e: The Third Buddhist Council (c. 250 BCE) was held at Pataliputra under Ashoka and presided over by Moggaliputta Tissa.

qe: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar' due to its frequent course changes and floods?
qh: बार-बार मार्ग बदलने और भीषण बाढ़ के कारण किस नदी को 'बिहार का शोक' कहा जाता है?
e: The Kosi River shifts its braided alluvial fan channels across North Bihar, causing recurring floods.

qe: The 'Ramsar Convention' (1971) is an international environmental treaty dedicated to the conservation of:
qh: 'रामसर सम्मेलन' (1971) किसके संरक्षण के लिए समर्पित एक अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पर्यावरण संधि है?
e: Signed in Ramsar (Iran) in 1971, it protects wetlands of international importance (such as Kanwar Lake / Kabartal in Begusarai, Bihar).

qe: Which is the only National Park located in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में स्थित एकमात्र राष्ट्रीय उद्यान (National Park) कौन-सा है?
e: Valmiki National Park and Tiger Reserve is located in West Champaran district of Bihar.

qe: Which soil covers the largest area in North Bihar's alluvial plains?
qh: उत्तरी बिहार के जलोढ़ मैदानों में सर्वाधिक क्षेत्रफल पर किस प्रकार की मिट्टी पाई जाती है?
e: Annual river deposits from the Gandak, Burhi Gandak, Bagmati, and Kosi create fertile Khadar (new alluvium) across North Bihar.

qe: The 'Montreal Protocol' (1987) is globally acclaimed for phasing out:
qh: 'मॉन्ट्रियल प्रोटोकॉल' (1987) विश्व स्तर पर किसके उन्मूलन (Phasing out) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Adopted in 1987, the Montreal Protocol successfully phased out ozone-depleting substances like chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs).

qe: Which river originates from the Amarkantak plateau and joins the Ganga near Patna?
qh: कौन-सी नदी अमरकंटक पठार से निकलती है और पटना के पास गंगा में मिलती है?
e: The Son River originates near Amarkantak (Madhya Pradesh) and flows northeast to join the Ganga near Danapur/Maner in Patna.

qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act granted Constitutional status to the National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) under Article 338B?
qh: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम ने अनुच्छेद 338B के अंतर्गत राष्ट्रीय पिछड़ा वर्ग आयोग (NCBC) को संवैधानिक दर्जा प्रदान किया?
e: The 102nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2018 inserted Articles 338B and 342A, giving NCBC constitutional status.

qe: What is the total outlay of the Bihar Budget 2026–27 presented on 3 February 2026?
qh: 3 फरवरी 2026 को प्रस्तुत बिहार बजट 2026–27 का कुल आकार (परिव्यय) लगभग कितना है?
e: Bihar Finance Minister Bijendra Prasad Yadav presented a record ₹3,47,589.76 crore budget for FY 2026–27 under the Saat Nischay-3 vision.

qe: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution can the President declare a National Emergency?
qh: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत राष्ट्रपति राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल (National Emergency) की घोषणा कर सकते हैं?
e: Article 352 = National Emergency, Article 356 = President's Rule in States, Article 360 = Financial Emergency.

qe: In the Union Budget 2026–27, what is the estimated fiscal deficit as a percentage of India's GDP?
qh: केंद्रीय बजट 2026–27 में भारत के सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) के प्रतिशत के रूप में राजकोषीय घाटा (Fiscal Deficit) कितना अनुमानित है?
e: Union Budget 2026–27 pegs the fiscal deficit at 4.3% of GDP, continuing the fiscal consolidation glide path.

qe: Which institution acts as the 'Lender of Last Resort' and regulates monetary policy in India?
qh: भारत में कौन-सी संस्था 'अंतिम ऋणदाता' (Lender of Last Resort) के रूप में कार्य करती है और मौद्रिक नीति को नियंत्रित करती है?
e: RBI is India's central bank, issuing currency, regulating commercial banks, and conducting monetary policy via the MPC.

qe: Which Part of the Indian Constitution deals with Panchayati Raj Institutions (inserted by the 73rd Amendment Act)?
qh: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा भाग पंचायती राज संस्थाओं से संबंधित है (73वें संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा जोड़ा गया)?
e: Part IX (Articles 243 to 243O) and the 11th Schedule were added by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992.

qe: What is the SI unit of electrical resistance?
qh: विद्युत प्रतिरोध (Electrical Resistance) की SI इकाई क्या है?
e: Resistance R = V/I is measured in Ohms (Ω).

qe: Which lens is used to correct Myopia (short-sightedness)?
qh: निकट दृष्टि दोष (Myopia) को ठीक करने के लिए किस लेंस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Myopia occurs when images focus in front of the retina; a diverging (concave) lens shifts focus back onto the retina.

qe: What is the chemical formula of Baking Soda?
qh: बेकिंग सोडा (खाने का सोडा) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: Baking soda is Sodium hydrogen carbonate (Sodium bicarbonate, NaHCO₃); Na₂CO₃·10H₂O is washing soda.

qe: What is the pH value of a neutral aqueous solution at 25°C?
qh: 25°C पर एक उदासीन जलीय घोल (Neutral Solution) का pH मान कितना होता है?
e: pH 7 is neutral; <7 is acidic and >7 is basic/alkaline.

qe: Which cell organelle is known as the 'Powerhouse of the Cell' because it produces ATP?
qh: किस कोशिकांग को ATP उत्पन्न करने के कारण 'कोशिका का पावरहाउस' कहा जाता है?
e: Mitochondria perform aerobic cellular respiration to generate ATP energy.

qe: Which gas is released during photosynthesis by green plants?
qh: हरे पौधों द्वारा प्रकाश संश्लेषण (Photosynthesis) के दौरान कौन-सी गैस मुक्त होती है?
e: Plants split water molecules using sunlight to release O₂ while fixing CO₂ into glucose.

qe: Which metal is liquid at standard room temperature?
qh: कौन-सी धातु सामान्य कमरे के तापमान पर द्रव (Liquid) अवस्था में पाई जाती है?
e: Mercury (Hg) is the only metal that is liquid at room temperature (~25°C); bromine is a liquid non-metal.

qe: Which country hosted the 18th BRICS Summit in September 2026?
qh: सितंबर 2026 में आयोजित 18वें BRICS शिखर सम्मेलन की मेजबानी किस देश ने की?
e: India hosted the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi on 12–13 September 2026.

qe: According to the 20th Bihar Economic Survey (2025–26), what was Bihar's GSDP growth rate at constant prices for 2024–25?
qh: 20वें बिहार आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण (2025–26) के अनुसार 2024–25 में स्थिर मूल्यों पर बिहार की GSDP वृद्धि दर कितनी रही?
e: Bihar recorded 8.6% growth at constant prices (outpacing India's 6.5%) and 13.1% at current prices.

qe: Which sector received the single highest budgetary allocation (₹68,216 crore) in the Bihar Budget 2026–27?
qh: बिहार बजट 2026–27 में किस क्षेत्र को सर्वाधिक बजटीय आवंटन (₹68,216 करोड़) प्राप्त हुआ?
e: Education received the highest sectoral allocation of ₹68,216 crore in Bihar Budget 2026–27, including plans for Panchayat model schools.

qe: Where was the UN Climate Change Conference 'COP31' held in November 2026?
qh: नवंबर 2026 में संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु परिवर्तन सम्मेलन 'COP31' कहाँ आयोजित हुआ?
e: COP31 took place in Antalya, Türkiye from 9–20 November 2026 (following COP29 in Baku and COP30 in Belém).

qe: Which new mission was announced in Union Budget 2026–27 to strengthen full-stack Indian IP and equipment manufacturing for chips?
qh: चिप्स के लिए पूर्ण-स्टैक भारतीय IP और उपकरण निर्माण को मजबूत करने हेतु केंद्रीय बजट 2026–27 में किस नए मिशन की घोषणा की गई?
e: Union Budget 2026–27 launched India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) 2.0 along with Biopharma SHAKTI.
